question: How many turkey poults will USDA NASS report as net placed in the United States during October 2026?

calls.reasoning: Prior: Oct 2025 revised level 21,284 times observed YoY growth (~+2% in Sep placements and Oct 1 eggs) ≈ 21,700. Sep→Oct seasonal ratio (1.084 in 2024, 1.115 in 2025) on 19,571 gives 21,220–21,820; egg-pipeline (Oct 1 eggs 26,695, +7.6% m/m vs +5.8% last year) via 2025 hatch/egg 0.88 and place/hatch 0.926 gives ~21,775. HPAI October wave in MN/ND/IA/WI turkey flocks (~175k birds depopulated) may defer some placements; shade median to ~21,600. Large 2026 benchmark revisions to history (Oct 2025 first print 19,684 vs current 21,284) widen uncertainty. No market found on Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi.
calls.dossier:
- NASS Turkey Hatchery Oct 13 2026 (tkha1026.txt): Sep 2026 net placements 19,571k (102% of Sep 2025 19,096k); Aug 2026 revised 21,164k (first print 21,213k in Sep 14 2026 report). Eggs in incubators Oct 1 2026 26,695k vs 26,122k Oct 1 2025 (102%); Sep 1 2026 24,814k (Sep1→Oct1 +7.6% in 2026 vs +5.8% in 2025). Poults hatched Sep 2026 21,122k (102%).
- Same report, prior-year (2025-26) current-basis placements: Sep 19,096; Oct 21,284; Nov 18,482; Dec 19,243; Jan 20,031; Feb 19,628; Mar 19,950; Apr 20,501; May 19,893; Jun 19,735; Jul 21,031; Aug 21,164. Hatched Oct 2025 22,981k; Sep 2025 20,738k.
- Sep 14 2026 report (tkha0926.txt): 2024-25 placements Sep 18,601; Oct 20,165 (Sep→Oct ratio 1.084); 2025 Sep→Oct ratio 21,284/19,096 = 1.115.
- Component ratios 2025: Oct hatch / Oct 1 eggs = 0.880; Oct placements / Oct hatch = 0.926; Sep 2026 placements/hatch = 0.927.
- REVISION WARNING: Dec 2025 report (tkha1225.txt) had first-print Oct 2025 = 19,684k, Sep 2025 = 18,179k, Oct 1 2025 eggs = 25,461k; these were later revised up ~5-8% (current: 21,284 / 19,096 / 26,122). Feb 2026 first print 18.5M later 19,628k; Jan 2026 first 20.3M later 20,031k. 2026 first prints since at least Aug appear to be on the new, higher basis (Aug revision only -49k).
- NASS reliability: net placements RMSE 4.2%, 90% CI ±7.1% (past 24 months).
- HPAI (per question background, APHIS summary Oct 30 2026): 11 commercial flocks in 30 days, incl. turkey flocks ND Dickey 60.6k (Oct 21), MN Roseau 57.5k and WI Barron 13.5k (Oct 22), IA Sac 44.4k (Oct 28); MN 20 commercial flocks lost in 2026. Mechanisms both ways: deferred placements in control areas vs. restocking/holiday demand.
- Status quo: Oct placements are seasonally among the highest months; YoY trend in recent months roughly +2% (Sep), +7% (Aug, vs revised 2025).
- Resolution: first print of Oct 2026 US net poult placements in Nov 13 2026 Turkey Hatchery report (thousands), not later revisions; not eggs/hatch figures.
- Event window: October 1–31, 2026 placements; as of Nov 2 2026 the month is 100% elapsed, figure unpublished until Nov 13.
- Searched, absent: any prediction market (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi) on this; any industry estimate of Oct 2026 placements; Nov 1 eggs figure (not yet released).

calls.reconciliation: Runs differed on median (21,300 vs ~21,600). The main factual dispute is whether first-print Sep→Oct ratios (1.05 in 2024, 1.083 in 2025) or revised ratios (1.084, 1.115) are relevant. Sep 2026's first print already appears to be on the revised basis (Aug revision only -49k), so revised ratios and the egg chain (~21,750) are more relevant, but there is residual risk that the Oct first print comes in low and is revised up later, as Oct 2025 was (19,684 first print). The size of the HPAI drag is a judgment call: small relative to national volume. Median set at 21,500, between the egg-chain point and a modest HPAI/first-print-risk discount. Reference class and approximate dispersion carried forward from the runs, widened slightly. No web retrieval this run.
